item.title: Help improve our youth soccer leagues!
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Take our survey and help improve our youth soccer leagues!

Thank you for participating in our youth soccer leagues! This year we had almost 1,800 youth participating in our leagues around Columbus.

Parent Survey

We strive to improve our programs and your feedback is important for our success. Please take our survey and share your experience with our program and the interactions with our community centers. 

Take our parent survey here.

Participant Survey

We would also love to hear directly from your child about their experience. If you have more than one child, the survey can be used more than once.

Take our participant survey here.

See You Next Season

We look forward to seeing you on the field next season and don't forget to check out all of our youth leagues at ColumbusRecParks.com.

item.title: Please complete this Youth Sports Soccer Survey
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Hello,

Thank you for participating in the first half of our 2021-2022 soccer season! We had a successful fall season and we are preparing for our spring season to start in April. We are partners in the U.S. Soccer Foundation’s Soccer for Success program and through this partnership, we are able to provide quality soccer programming and equipment. In order to fulfill our partnership requirements, we would appreciate if you would have your child complete this survey. 

The survey should only take a few minutes and is available in both English and Spanish using the links below. You will also need a site number, please use the chart below.
